description: Finite tests with paired negative controls for the mova-json library and CLI-level operations.
forward: Twelve tests covering round trip, escapes, path edits, sorted insertion, replace_str, JSONL, merges, conflicts, offset mapping, rebind and rebind-groupant.
inverse: Typed behavior complement first and nonunique reverse reconstruction second; see model.md.
Each positive check has a red control; a failing test names the property, not the mutated line.
limitations: No concurrent-writer, non-UTF-8 or Windows-path coverage.
state: Repository JSON files and temporary git repositories.
